title: League of Legends: New Dawn Unveiled With Debut Trailer, Riot Announces Major Overhaul Coming in 2027
summary: At the 2026 League of Legends World Championship Finals, Riot Games officially unveiled League of Legends: New Dawn. The large-scale update is scheduled for 2027 and will bring changes to the game's client, Summoner's Rift, visuals, and gameplay, marking the beginning of a new chapter for one of the industry's most enduring titles.
